neighbor_direction_control.boundary: Descriptive within-stratum direction control, not a causal test or a training gate; limited exchangeable coverage may make it inconclusive.

boundaries: Maximum matching is score-independent geometric upper coverage, NOT achievable AP or official recall.
Matched GT identity can vary among equal-cardinality solutions; only image totals are compared.
Density/neighbor direction remain confounded; candidate geometry-selected bias is not training root cause.
NMS witness counts are candidate events, not recoverable unique GT; rows also record surviving alternatives.
Continuous geometry/argmax classes and pre-ignore candidates are distinct from official AP.

official.aggregation_note: Exact calcAccuracy.m class-availability weighting, which repeats a class once per image containing it.

official_reference.aggregation_note: Exact calcAccuracy.m class-availability weighting, which repeats a class once per image containing it.

ignore_audit.fp_audit_note: Greedy IoU=0.50 class-wise matching before class-0 raster filtering; ignored score-zero GT matches are neutral.
